title: Watch: 'Other Life' Doc Short Exploring UFO Sightings in South Wales
description: "Massive orb. And I mean really big." "It was like you shoved a village in the air." 👽 Ready to hear some more wacky UFO stories? Dive in and enjoy this short film to hear some tales of strange spacecraft. Other Life is a 17-minute short film from the UK made by the brothers Tom Tennant and Theo Tennant. This premiered at the DOC NYC and PÖFF Shorts last fall, and has been playing around festivals ever since, now ready to be watched online. The UFO/UAP craze continues! After Spielberg's Disclosure Day this summer, follow-up with this short film. Mike & Emlyn, best friends and UFO investigators, cruise along the roads of South Wales in a multi-coloured van. They interview individuals who have encountered the unexplainable; from shimmering orbs, to huge spacecrafts, to cascading beams of light. Their mission is to document these sightings in an effort to investigate what they could mean and where these phenomena come from. This doc is more of a nice slice-of-life look at these people than an investigation into the UFO sightings. View below. 🛸 Thanks to Short of the Week for the tip on this debuting online.
